product_overview: Super Routine is a day-and-night supplement landing page that presents the product, explains the formulation, and collects founding-waitlist signups with a multi-step preference survey. The site also includes legal pages and a 3D hero experience that degrades gracefully for users without WebGL or with reduced-motion preferences.
core_goals: Help visitors understand the Super Routine day and night supplement system.
Let visitors complete a multi-step founding-member survey and join the waitlist.
Show the 2-sachet product breakdown with supplement details.
Provide access to legal information through privacy and terms pages.

features.name: Waitlist Survey and Registration
features.description: A multi-step founding-member questionnaire that collects product preferences, basic contact details, and consent before submitting a waitlist signup.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select packaging preference option -> Select supplement format option -> Choose build type or select custom supplement ingredients -> Adjust monthly budget price slider range -> Enter first name and Indian WhatsApp mobile number -> Check consent agreement checkbox -> Submit the waitlist form -> See confirmation with queue position

Navigate to / -> Select invalid phone details -> Enter the form information -> Attempt to submit the waitlist form -> See validation feedback and correct the phone number -> Submit the waitlist form -> See confirmation with queue position

features.name: 2-Sachet Product Showcase and Supplement Breakdown
features.description: An interactive product section that explains the Day and Night sachets and lets visitors inspect the included supplements and their dosages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse the Day and Night sachet showcase -> Inspect the AM energizing nutrients -> Inspect the PM restorative compounds -> View individual supplement tiles and dosage details
Navigate to / -> Open the product breakdown section -> Review the active forms and dosages for each supplement -> Continue browsing the supplement tiles

features.name: Navigation and Legal Information
features.description: Footer navigation that lets visitors open the site’s legal pages and read policy information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the footer area -> Go to /terms -> Read the terms and company policy information
Navigate to / -> Open the footer area -> Go to /privacy -> Read the privacy policy and contact information
